customer: I'm trying to get rid of the leased cargo van I drive since we're going down to one car, and I'm getting nowhere. It's through Ironwood Lease, can you just buy it out from them or not?
agent: I'm sorry for the hassle. Per our article "Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts," Ironwood Lease doesn't allow us to buy out your lease directly. You can buy the van out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease (see "Selling vs. turning in at lease end"). To get started, take a look at "Selling a car that you lease."
